item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 27/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The anticyclone aloft now covering the coast of southern China will weaken gradually today and tomorrow. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coastal areas of Guangdong during the weekend. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect Guangdong early to midweek next week. The weather will be generally fine and dry over the region. It will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night.
